latestDirection: 하늘색에서 연한 초록색 섬광 느낌으로 변경. 엠퍼러 상위 위상과 장식 사각 프레임 유지.

edits.name: 갑옷
edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / lighting-weather. Edit this existing framed MYTHIC SF equipment icon. USER CORRECTION: replace the sky-blue energy palette with PALE LIGHT GREEN FLASHES. This is equipment ABOVE the Emperor tier, and must have a rich imposing mythic science-fiction presence.
Preserve EXACTLY the equipment's design, geometry, camera angle, amount of armor detail, platinum-white and gold material shapes, black structural machinery, object size and position. Preserve EXACTLY the ornate SQUARE metal frame, all four corners, top and bottom emblems, and fine details. Do not simplify anything. Do not add parts, remove parts or move the object.
Change ONLY the emission/light palette and the colored background atmosphere: every blue/cyan light in the equipment, all reactors, energy couplings, armor slits, edge rails, frame corner chambers and frame emblems becomes a vivid yet PALE LIME GREEN light. Light sources have WHITE-HOT centers, pale lime-green corona (#C8FF91, #E6FFCD), and a concentrated saturated green falloff. It must clearly read light GREEN, NOT mint, turquoise, teal, sky blue or cold blue. Preserve the metallic silver/platinum and champagne gold surfaces; they catch small pale-green reflections but remain metal, not green paint.
Replace the blue cosmic atmosphere with a deep near-black forest-green energy backdrop. Give the power cores a refined intense light-green FLASH presence: a few sharp short green-white light rays, brighter layered reactor glow, tiny luminous green particles and controlled green volumetric shafts behind the item. Keep all metal edges and core ring engineering legible; do not wash out the image, engulf it in smoke or hide the silhouette. Highly controlled luminous depth and contrast to feel more powerful than ornate Emperor gear. No magic runes, gems, added fantasy ornaments, text, logos, labels or nameplate. Keep the exact square framing, keep all existing gear and corners fully visible, opaque background.
Target equipment: 갑옷. Preserve its exact number of components and all connections.
